entities.title: keygen, sign and trust as prebuilt signed scripts in the Keychain
entities.summary: keygen, sign and trust are built-in zazzled commands with software P-256 keys in ~/.zazzle/keys (0600), not the prebuilt universal native binaries signed by a pinned release authority, using the Keychain or Secure Enclave, that D7 and D12 settled.
entities.details: The plan's §6 and phase 7: a zazz-builtins crate whose keygen makes a non-exportable key in the Secure Enclave (or a Keychain software key) and can emit a CSR, whose sign uses the Keychain key, shipped as signed .zazz files embedded in zazzled with kind native-bin, accepted only from the release authority whose key is pinned in zazzled. Today pipeline.rs refuses native-bin outright and the keys are files.
entities.compromise: Software keys in files instead of non-exportable Keychain or Secure Enclave keys; the commands are compiled into zazzled rather than run as scripts.

origin.reference: macos/rust/zazzled/ZAZZ-PLAN.md, Implementation status (first item); §2 D7 and D12; §6; §14 phase 7

entities.title: Exercise the macOS Keychain trust path in CI
entities.summary: On macOS trust also reads the root-owned /etc/zazzle/trust.d; the Keychain path (SecTrust evaluation, and trust settings on `trust add`) compiles but is not exercised by CI.
entities.details: trust.rs keychain_trusts runs only when Zazz uses the system trust locations, which tests replace with their own, so CI never reaches SecTrust; signing.rs add_to_os likewise.

entities.title: Move the zazz OIDs to a registered enterprise number
entities.summary: The zazz code-signing EKU and the grants extension OIDs sit under IANA's example enterprise number 32473 until a registered Private Enterprise Number replaces them.
entities.details: Changing them invalidates every authority certificate made with the current OIDs; zazz-format owns the constants.

entities.title: WebAssembly components and wasi:http
entities.summary: Network for signed WASM scripts goes through zazz_host.http; wasi:http and components are not linked, and there is no component transport: only core WASI preview 1 commands run.
entities.details: The plan's transport 3: the WIT world zazz:script@1 mirroring the zazz_host functions, with wasi:http linked only for signed scripts behind the same host check (and zazz-worker's dependency on wasmtime-wasi-http). Today engine.rs allows only wasi_snapshot_preview1 and the five zazz_host imports.

origin.reference: macos/rust/zazzled/ZAZZ-PLAN.md, Implementation status (fourth and fifth items); §10 Transports 3; §14 phase 12

entities.title: An SDK HTTP client for native scripts
entities.summary: Native scripts get no SDK HTTP client: call.http() works only in the WASM backend, through zazz_host.http.
entities.details: The native backend builds every call with NoHttp (zazz-sdk native.rs run_call), so a natively trusted script granted network still has no SDK client; only the WASM backend's HostHttp reaches zazz_host.http.
